personality_one_liner: An inviting, lightweight, and modern spiritual productivity tool that feels frictionless and uplifting.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Clear padding between groups. Avoid dense dash-boarding.

do's: Use blur on bottom tab bar.
Use soft frosted overlay on the Next Prayer featured card.
Use blur for the active blocker modal over the blurred background.
dont's: Don't stack more than 2 blurred surfaces.
Don't use it on simple list items.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the app, Google/Guest login, and demonstrate the App Blocker and required permissions.
screens.layout: Full-bleed onboarding scenes. Use a simple stack with descriptive text and an illustration. Final slide has a button to trigger the 'Demo Blocker', showing exactly how the App Blocker works. Sticky CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard showing next prayer time, daily ayat, and quick actions.

states.empty: No location set -> Prompt to set location.
states.error: Failed to fetch prayer times -> Retry button.

screens.layout: Header with settings icon. Hero card for 'Next Prayer' countdown (with frosted glass over blue sky background). Below hero: 2-column grid for quick links (Quran, Qibla). Below grid: 'Ayat of the Day' card.

screens.name: QuranFull
screens.purpose: Read the full Quran with Indonesian translation.
screens.layout: Search bar at top. Simple vertical list of Surahs. On tap, navigates to reader view. Reader view is minimalist: Arabic text on top, translation below it, generously spaced.

screens.name: Qibla
screens.purpose: Compass pointing to Qibla with automatic or manual location input.
screens.layout: Large minimal compass visual in the center. Location toggle (Auto/Manual) below it. Simple, distraction-free screen.

screens.name: StreakAchievements
screens.purpose: Display prayer winstreak, calendar, and levels (Awan, Bintang, Purnama, Syams).
screens.layout: Hero area shows current level (e.g., 'Level Awan' with animated SVG icon). Below: horizontal calendar row showing recent days. Below: 'Share to Medsos' button and progress bar to next level.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configuration, Ads setup, and Pro Feature previews.
screens.layout: List of settings items grouped by category. A prominent 'Premium Features' card that showcases Dark Theme, Rakaat Counter, Widgets, and Rain Sounds.

screens.name: ActiveBlockerModal
screens.purpose: The actual blocking screen that interrupts user when Azan is active.
screens.layout: Full-screen modal. Blurred background. Center text: 'Waktunya Sholat' (Time to pray). A large 'Hold to Say Alhamdulillah' button (long press required) and a small 'Ingatkan Nanti' (Remind me later) text button at the bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Light blue (brandPrimary: #0EA5E9) is explicitly allowed by the prompt as it was a literal request by the user ('biru muda').
For the UI, keep it 'simpel dan ringan' (simple and lightweight) using the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality. Generous padding, rounded corners, clean sans-serif typography (Plus Jakarta Sans).

Build a custom 'Hold to Dismiss' button in ActiveBlockerModal using GestureHandler to simulate the 'Saying Alhamdulillah' verification requirement for MVP. This handles the 'harus ditekan lama baru hilang' (must be long-pressed to dismiss) requirement.

Implement the 'Awan, Bintang, Purnama, Syams' achievement icons using React Native SVG to keep the app lightweight, avoiding external image dependencies where possible (as requested). Only use the provided Unsplash backgrounds for the Home hero or Settings Pro banner.
Ensure dark mode is fully built out but framed as a 'Pro Feature' preview in the Settings page.
The App Blocker must have a 'Demo' button in the onboarding so users can experience the blocking UI and the long-press dismiss mechanism before enabling it.
For the Qibla compass, include both automatic (device sensor) and manual input fallbacks as specified.
For the Quran feature, include full text and Indonesian translations, ensuring proper RTL support for Arabic text and a clean typography hierarchy.
For the calendar and streak page, use a horizontal or grid layout that clearly shows missing days ('bolong-bolong') and allows sharing progress to social media ('bagikan ke medsos').
